items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for these issues.

items.title: Amasty patches 25 Magento extensions, 1 critical
items.summary: Amasty issued a massive security release for 25 extensions, with one critical vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution. Sansec Shield already blocks the critical issues.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, leading to remote code execution. All versions up to and including 3.16.0 are affected, with a fix in version 4.0.0.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: Sansec discovered an unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer that can lead to remote code execution via a crafted cookie. All versions before 1.11.12 are vulnerable, and Mirasvit released a patched version 1.11.12.

items.title: PolyShell: unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical flaw in Magento's REST API allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to any store by bypassing validation with a polyglot. Adobe fixed it in Magento 2.4.9, but older supported versions lack an isolated patch.

items.title: Critical Security Update: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source (APSB26-05)
items.summary: This critical security update addresses multiple vulnerabilities, including incorrect authorization, improper access control, stored XSS, and path traversal, which could lead to privilege escalation and remote code execution in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Adobe Commerce versions 2.4.9-alpha2 and earlier are affected by an Incorrect Authorization vulnerability. A low-privileged attacker could leverage this to bypass security measures and gain unauthorized access to elevated privileges.

items.title: SessionReaper, unauthenticated RCE in Magento & Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows customer account takeover and unauthenticated remote code execution under certain conditions, with mass attacks observed in the wild. Adobe released an emergency fix, but unpatched stores remain vulnerable to malware uploads.

items.title: CosmicSting attack & defense overview
items.summary: CosmicSting is a critical bug allowing attackers to read any files, steal secret crypt keys, and inject malicious JavaScript to steal customer data. Combined with another bug, it can lead to remote code execution and backdoor installation.

items.title: Critical CVE-2025-24434 Vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This critical vulnerability abuses improper authorization, which could result in an unauthenticated attacker elevating their privileges, malicious remote code execution, and gaining unauthorized access without user interaction.
